note: Replaces both dry-run bodies with one _dry_run_cohorts method taking the ineligibility predicate and a kind label.
Wraps groups/variants in CASE jsonb_typeof guards so scalar values do not abort the stale query; time predicates stay in flag_status.py.
Moves stepper steps to a SCANNER_STEPPER_STEPS module constant and reads stepErrors as a logic selector instead of computing in JSX.
Filters dateMapping presets by a set of stable key labels instead of matching raw range value tokens.
Adds capture_exception calls in both except blocks but keeps the Prometheus error counter alongside.
Blast-radius message now uses shared extractValidationError, covering 512 as well as 400/513; hardcoded status check removed.
Drops the local raw-string status set and reads FAILED_BACKFILL_STATUSES from the batch exports facade api.
Extracts the copy popover and its state into a shared useCellCopyContextMenu hook used by LemonTable and OutputPane.
Removes pub(super) from uncovered_from, making it private to the impl.
Adds a doc comment line stating the plain iconless styling is the standard for in-app feedback buttons.
Adds a comment on PersonSearchMatchField pointing to filter_conditions and TAG_BY_FIELD to keep in step.
Collapses per-partition maps into one HashMap<TopicPartition, BatchPartition> with span, generation, charges, ts and lag fields.
pinned_connect_host now returns a target with host and tls_server_name; source reads them and drops unbracket_host import.
Setup logic connects and dispatches productToursLogic.createTour, removing the local create path and creatingFirstTour flag.
Caller passes previous rollout whenever a previous set exists and drops changedAspects import; the card decides display.
Adds a shared listAllPages helper and rewrites the alerts pager (and evaluation reports) to just the request.
Introduces DUPLICATE_KEY_SELF_HANDLED set with an ownership comment and checks membership instead of a bare string.
Deletes the dead variantRolloutSum and areVariantRolloutsValid selectors and their type declarations, and the redundant docstring.
Moves scopes_not_covered into scopes.py built on _with_read_halves; permissions.py imports it.
Adds deriveOverflowKey (message key, redirect header, token:distinct_id fallback) used by rate-limit and TTL refresh steps.
